channel.title: WBBJ 7 Eyewitness News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from WBBJ 7 Eyewitness News (wbbjtv.com)

item.title: Funeral arrangements announced for fallen Deputy Derrick Bonham
item.description: The Weakley County Sheriff's Office has announced funeral arrangements for fallen officer, Deputy Derrick Bonham.

item.title: Hardin Co. EMA: Residents should report structural damages
item.description: Hardin County Emergency Management Agency is requesting that those residents in the county who have experienced structural damage to their primary residence should report those findings.

item.title: Semi-truck overturns on I-40
item.description: According to a WBBJ news tipster, a wreck occurred involving a semi-truck Saturday morning on I-40 near mile marker 70.

item.title: ‘Sanford and Son’ star Demond Wilson dies at 79, reports say
item.description: Actor Demond Wilson, who starred on the popular sitcom “Sanford and Son,” died Friday, according to several reports. He was 79.

item.title: Weakley Co. Mayor issues Executive Order for Flags to Half-Staff honoring Deputy Bonham
item.description: Weakley County Mayor Dale Hutcherson issues an Executive Order for the lowering of flags to half-staff for Deputy Derrick Bonham.

item.title: Mann’s Wrecker Service talks winter storm towing
item.description: Road conditions have been a problem for residents across Jackson and West TN since the start of the winter storm.

item.title: Some Jackson residents enjoy the icy conditions
item.description: Despite the frigid temperatures, residents spend some time enjoying the ice and snow.

item.title: Local residents express concern over Jackson roads
item.description: Roadways throughout the City of Jackson have seen snow, sleet, ice, and the community is wondering when they will see asphalt.

item.title: Some Jackson businesses affected by winter storm
item.description: The City of Jackson has faced some inclement weather conditions and the fallout is still affecting businesses.

item.title: Judge orders 5-year-old Liam Conejo Ramos and his dad released from ICE detention
item.description: A 5-year-old boy and his father must be released by Tuesday from the Texas center where they've been held after being detained by immigration officers in Minnesota, a federal judge ordered Saturday in a ruling that harshly criticized the Trump administration's approach to enforcement.
